farmhouse.name: Abandoned Farmhouse
farmhouse.text: A shell-scarred farmhouse sits off the road. The windows are dark. Something could be inside: supplies, or a booby trap.

choices.label: Search it (gain an attachment; 50% chance: lose 8 Resolve)

resistance.name: French Resistance Contact
resistance.text: A farmer waves you over. He works with the Resistance and offers help, for a price, or for some decent food.

choices.label: Pay 50 Supply (gain a random rare card)

stragglers.name: Stragglers
stragglers.text: A handful of paratroopers, scattered by the night drop, stumble out of the hedgerows.

choices.label: Take them in (add a Rifle Squad)
Send them to scout ahead (lose 5 Resolve, gain a Commendation)

field_hospital.name: Field Hospital
field_hospital.text: A battalion aid station has set up in a church. The surgeons can patch up your worn-out squads.

choices.label: Pay 30 Supply (clear all casualties in your deck)

supply_dump.name: Abandoned Supply Dump
supply_dump.text: A German supply dump, hastily abandoned. Crates of gear, and a few jerrycans.

choices.label: Sell the fuel to the motor pool (+60 Supply)

mail_call.name: Mail Call
mail_call.text: The mail jeep finally caught up. Letters from home, and a parcel of field manuals from battalion.

choices.label: Study the manuals (upgrade a random card)

liberated_village.name: Liberated Village
liberated_village.text: The villagers pour out of their cellars with cider and flowers. A few young men want to join you.

choices.label: Celebrate with them (+6 max Resolve, heal 6)
Take the volunteers (add a Combat Engineers card)

captured_officer.name: Captured Officer
captured_officer.text: Your patrol drags in a German Hauptmann. He has a map case and an expensive watch.

choices.label: Send him to the rear with the map (gain a Commendation)
Trade the watch with the Quartermaster (+50 Supply)
